note: Prompt templates for governed n8n model jobs, rendered SERVER-SIDE by scripts/lib/n8n_model_job.build_messages from a template_id the caller names. The caller never supplies prompt text; placeholders are filled from the job's resolved artifact and the named output contract only. Placeholders: {{schema_id}}, {{schema_keys}}, {{schema_required}}, {{correlation_id}}, {{artifact_sha256}}, {{artifact}} (one-pass substitution; inserted text is never re-scanned). Each template is bound to one registered n8n_* process (PROCESS_TASK_TYPE); a template named for another process is a typed refusal (template_mismatch). max_artifact_bytes caps the serialised artifact placed in the prompt. The two v1 templates reproduce the inline 2026-10-07 prompt byte for byte (pinned by tests/test_n8n_model_job_20261007.py).
